notes: Captured and read full-page screenshots at 375px, 393px and 900px for mandag 14. september's agenda.

Match names render fully at all widths, no truncation that hides a side or a key detail — e.g. 'Kolstad – Industria Kielce', 'Nottingham Forest – Coventry City', 'Manchester City – Sunderland' all readable end to end.
Every visible event carries a channel line, and all are Norwegian: TV 2 Play, TV 2, TV 2 Sport 2, Viaplay, VG+ Sport, HBO Max (Sport) — no FOX/ESPN/Sky or other foreign broadcaster seen.

Times are consistent 24h format and sensibly placed in the fixed time column; multi-day items (BMW PGA Championship 17.-20. september, Biltmore Championship 17.-21. september, Norge-Kina Davis Cup 18.-19. september, UCI Road World Championships tempo events) show date ranges correctly instead of a single misleading day.
Club crests and small sport icons render as intended (no broken-image boxes) across Premier League, La Liga, Bundesliga, Eliteserien and UEFA Europa League rows.
No horizontal scroll or edge clipping at any width, including the tightest 375px column.

Single quiet column, clear day-grouped headings (I DAG / I MORGEN / weekday dates), generous row spacing; at 900px the agenda stays centered in a ~640px column with empty margin either side rather than stretching full width. Must-see amber accent dots appear on a minority of rows only (e.g. Boda/Glimt–Sandefjord, Elche–Real Madrid, Norge–Kina, several weekend Eliteserien/Premier League rows), not on everything.

Header (wordmark, date, theme toggle), 'Kveldsbrifen' editorial line, day headings, 'Dette dekker vi' / 'Merker og kilder' disclosures, and footer (oppdatert-dato, kalenderabonnement, AI-budsjett line) are all intact and aligned at every width.

On the 900px screenshot the floating Assistent button (sparkles, bottom-trailing) sits over a mid-agenda row in the 'I MORGEN' section (Alavés – Valencia) — this is the sanctioned iOS 26 floating-button idiom per DESIGN.md § Hjelperen, not a finding. It does not cover the last agenda row or the footer text in this capture.
